description.narrative: Three active members of BB will participate in two LARP activities in Denmark; “A week in Copenhagen” and Knudepunkt 2023, which is the main venue of cooperation and exchange of experiences between Nordic and international roleplaying gamers and experts. Because BB is working on “The LARP Factory” LARP academy, which aims to help Palestinian youth become active citizens living & working in a safe and loving space that celebrates expression & stimulates the creative imagination, with the help of Bifrost we are creating a curriculum intended to cover writing, designing and facilitating LARP games as well as board games, in hopes of creating new experienced LARP designers, writers, facilitators and players all over Palestine. This means that BB now needs all the experience and knowledge available within our partners and the social network attending Knudepunkt. Participating in Knudepunkt 2023 in Denmark will be instrumental to strengthen BB’s partnerships, promoting its new activities, strategy and structure and gaining the knowledge needed for our project.
